subject: general
question: The difference between the total surface area and lateral surface area of a cube, if side of the cube is 11 cm (in square cm), is _________ .
solution:
**Given:**

Side of the cube = 11 cm

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a cube = 6 × (side)²

Lateral Surface Area (LSA) of a cube = 4 × (side)²

Difference between TSA and LSA = TSA - LSA

**Calculation:**

Side = 11 cm

Total Surface Area (TSA) = 6 × (11)²

TSA = 6 × 121

TSA = 726 cm²

Lateral Surface Area (LSA) = 4 × (11)²

LSA = 4 × 121

LSA = 484 cm²

Difference between TSA and LSA = TSA - LSA

⇒ 726 - 484

⇒ 242 cm²

**The difference between the total surface area and lateral surface area of the cube is 242 cm².**
